scope: single isolated SOURCE-FREE synthetic development experiment; no original-world first use or canonical learner change
coordinator: Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work/PR1278 sole integration owner; PR1327 independent contributor

predecessors.negative_finding: 3/3 regime cue identities exposed without actions, plus phase leaks via numeric Q/P/Q IDs

source_design.feature_matrix: Probe 16 complete 4-bit candidate patterns permuted with fixed seed; common FIT patterns 0000 and 1111; HELD 16 complete patterns permuted independently; each feature 17 zeros and 17 ones
source_design.object_identifiers: Opaque role-independent salted hash; same source bytes for all 4 hidden causal roles
source_design.subject_identifiers: Opaque role-independent salted hash, no A/B task phase or role namespace; same source bytes for all 4 roles
source_design.source_cohort_roles: No A/B cohort or task-phase signal exists; probe/FIT/held positions are predeclared experiment sampling metadata, not role-dependent
source_design.fact_source: NKR08 read-only historical TRAIN image plus source-typed direct synthetic delta; static fact graph identical for all 4 hidden causal roles

outcome_rule: For any hidden causal role k, reward(entity,action)=0 if action=0 else direct_fact_bit(entity,predicate[k]); reward oracle never accessible to source-only selector

active_selection.selection: At each step enumerate remaining candidate roles, for each unqueried probe entity and action compute partition of predicted outcomes using candidate rule; choose maximum Shannon entropy with stable tie-break on hashed source ID; update candidate set using separately revealed witnessed consequence
active_selection.winner: After exactly 2 selected probe actions, identify unique hidden role or abstain
active_selection.no_action_control: Source-only hypothesis set {0,1,2,3}; since exact same factual source across roles, cannot identify hidden role, must abstain
comparison_controls: independent exact symbolic active partition selector with same candidate assumptions, actions and source observations
two budget-matched random actions on probe entities, fixed seeds and selection independent of hidden role
fixed action=0 on two probe entities, outcomes always 0

post_identification_native.original_class: NativeContextAccumulator(context_bits=1) at SAME address 0, max_degree=2; degree-two interaction term needed for reward=action*selected_bit; original module unchanged
post_identification_native.fit_stage_A: 4 separately witnessed outcomes from two fixed entity patterns 0000/1111 with both actions, task/role independent; native and symbolic/tree controls see equal information
post_identification_native.stage_B: 2 previously disclosed selected active probe outcomes, stage_update at same address, without replay of A raw records
post_identification_native.retention: All old A readouts/fingerprint unchanged after B and after cold restore; original archived accepted state never touched
post_identification_native.held_evaluation: 16 never-actuated HELD entities x both actions for each of 3 seeds x4 hidden roles =384 held predictions, 192 held action decisions
strong_controls: fully refitted original NativeContextBasis with identical A+B witnessed actions
independent fully fitted symbolic conditional count model on selected cue bit and action
fully fitted conventional two-input binary decision tree on identical A+B evidence
post_identification_native.source_without_actions: all role alternatives share exactly same static Q/P/Q facts and IDs, equal per-feature marginals and temporal grouping; no side channel

acceptance.engineering: same source for each of 4 roles per seed, zero-action 0/12 resolved; active 12/12 resolved in 2 interventions, exact symbolic active control ties, old A readout change 0, native/full refit/symbolic/tree held Brier 0, source and model immutability; Linux+Windows final full regression, original historical archive compatibility PASS
acceptance.science: Improvement >0.01 Brier over EACH fully trained equal-source/action exact symbolic, full native refit and conventional control on independent owner-qualified original-world evaluation with new first-use authority; strong control ties => DEV_NO_GO_STRONGEST_CONTROL_TIE

limitations: Source-design validity and intervention necessity in a deterministic synthetic counterfactual family are not discovery of new model class, unknown-world generalization, native autonomous intervention value, or canonical cumulative model training. Active partition policy is analytic and equally available to symbolic control.
prohibitions: no new controller, runner or schedule
no causal promotion of raw Q/P/Q facts
no independent permanent model training owner
no leakage from source ID or known phase
